messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: Increased tail latency and packet loss observed from instances in eu-central-1a affecting inference-serving tier. Auto-runbooks triggered: `net_slowpath_detect` and `route_fallback`. Link: https://telemetry.redwood.ai/alerts/2018765432 :rotating_light:

eli (oncall): grabbing it. seeing elevated `recv_err` and `tx_retries` on a subset of g5 nodes in eu-central-1a. latency spikes ~200-600ms for token emission.

maria (sre): confirmed. CloudWatch shows ENI attach/detach churn + 5 ASG instances reporting network RX drops ~5-12% over 6m. Not full termination, looks like degraded NIC path.

ajay (eng-runtime): any impact on KV cache hits / sticky sessions?

maria (sre): yes cache miss rate up ~18% for long-context requests, likely due to session reconnects -> cold KV loads. Throughput falling ~25% for heavy chat routes.

eli (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) mark eu-central-1a as reduced-capacity in routing policy 2) spin up additional warm capacity in eu-central-1b 3) start graceful connection draining of affected instances 4) fallback lower-throughput quantized model for best-effort customers. executing now. @cs-team please prepare customer comms for impacted SLAs. :eyes:

sam (support): on it. pulling list of active sessions and 95th-percentile impacted customers. will draft note.

maria (sre): running command to tag ASG and drain instances:
```bash
# mark instances unhealthy in our register
aws autoscaling set-instance-health --instance-id i-0abc1234 --health-status Unhealthy --region eu-central-1
# cordon + drain at runtime layer
for pod in $(kubectl get pods -l app=inference -o name); do kubectl drain $pod --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60; done
```

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline `route-update-eu` started. Job: apply new routing weights -> eu-central-1b: 0.75, eu-central-1a: 0.25.

ajay (eng-runtime): adding a temporary fallback rule to prefer smaller KV caches + shorter max_seq for chat-heavy routes to reduce cold loads. Pushing config now.

eli (oncall): telemetry update: after routing shift (~2m ago) error rate dropped 40% and tail latency reduced to ~120-250ms. some customers still on 1a sticky sessions; continuing drain.

maria (sre): noticed 2 instances repeatedly flapping their ENI state. opened AWS support ticket 1234567890 -> suspect host-level network impairment in that AZ isolated to a rack.

sam (support): compiling impacted customers: 4 enterprise customers showing >30% increase in latency for embed/generation routes. Preparing short advisory and CTA for CS.

cs-team: draft ready, please review. We recommend informing them of degraded performance in eu-central-1a, automatic routing to eu-central-1b, and suggested mitigation: pin to eu-central-1b if they need stability.

eli (oncall): handoff note for next oncall (in 30m):
- current state: routing weights adjusted, affected instances drained, AWS SR opened.
- impact: degraded token latency and elevated error rate for customers with sessions pinned to eu-central-1a. Majority traffic is now on 1b.
- open actions: follow AWS SR, observe for flapping or capacity starvation, consider cross-region spill (eu-west-1) if 1b reaches >80% util.

maria (sre): adding a short-lived autoscaling policy: allow burst to standby pool in eu-central-1b, scale_target 20% above baseline for 15m. Monitoring CPU/GPU queue depth.

ajay (eng-runtime): temporarily reducing batch sizes on eu-central-1b workers to keep latency stable while we warm more nodes.

eli (oncall): Note: will page infra on-call in 20m if AWS SR doesn't show clear rack repair ETA. Also flag Security/Compliance for any customers requiring geo pinning changes.

deploy-bot: route-update-eu completed successfully.

maria (sre): follow-up logs snippet from a flapping host:
```
[2026-03-15T09:42:12Z] net: link reset, enic0 state DOWN
[2026-03-15T09:42:14Z] enic0: RX errors spike, queue dropped 1100 pkts
[2026-03-15T09:42:20Z] enic0 state UP, session reconnects 420
```

sam (support): sent advisory to impacted customers, included temporary mitigation steps and ETA: investigating with AWS, will update in 60m.

eli (oncall): current metrics snapshot -> overall token throughput recovered to 88% baseline, tail latency 95th=240ms, error rate down by 36% since peak. keeping SEV2 but lowering paging frequency.

maria (sre): AWS replied: "isolated networking degradation on host fleet, mitigation in progress, estimated fix 45-90 minutes". AWS SR 1234567890 -> assigned to networking team.

ajay (eng-runtime): note for postmortem: evaluate better session migration to avoid cold KV spikes when draining. We saw cache misses amplify the impact.

eli (oncall): handing off to night oncall @maria in 30m. Leaving runbook, current routing weights, AWS SR link, and updated customer list in the incident doc. If 1b crosses 80% util, escalate to Eng Leads for cross-region spill.

maria (sre): acknowledged, taking over at T+30. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident state updated -> ACTIVE -> MONITORING. SEV2. Incident channel: #incidents/2018765432.

eli (oncall): closing timeline note for now. will add full timeline and actions to the incident doc after final AWS confirmation. Thanks all for quick turn. :pray:
